title: fix-network module diagram
description: The tool's modules and how they depend on each other. Every effect on the machine passes through the Sys trait, so the tests can swap the real Mac for a scripted one.

components.name: fix-network sources
components.responsibility: The whole tool, compiled into one binary.

components.name: Command line (main.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses diagnose and fix with their flags, refuses anything but macOS, records the original settings, and runs a diagnosis, a dry run or the repair, then picks the exit status.

components.name: Snapshot (facts.rs)
components.responsibility: Takes a fresh snapshot of link, routes, DNS resolvers, proxies, VPN services, public-internet probes and each internal host.

components.name: Parsers (parse.rs)
components.responsibility: Pure parsers for networksetup, ifconfig, netstat, route, scutil, sysctl and dig output, and for --internal-host targets.

components.name: Checks (assess.rs, corp.rs)
components.responsibility: Judge the seven dimensions of one snapshot and record each problem as a finding with its remedy, given the steps already tried.

components.name: Result types (model.rs)
components.responsibility: Check states, repair steps with their order and gates, remedies, findings and reports.

components.name: Repair (repair.rs)
components.responsibility: Plans the steps a report calls for, runs the adaptive fix loop under the flag gates, and carries out each step.

components.name: Report (report.rs)
components.responsibility: Prints checks, findings with their outcomes, plans and actions as text, or the whole run as JSON.

components.name: Session and helpers (run.rs)
components.responsibility: The per-run state directory, its redacted diagnostic.log and original.json, terminal colours and small text helpers.

components.name: Machine access (sys.rs)
components.responsibility: The Sys trait and its real implementation: bounded commands (with sudo when asked), system name lookups, TCP connects, pauses, the clock, SSH detection and the detached Wi-Fi watchdog; plus the scripted Mac the tests use.

components.name: macOS network commands
components.responsibility: networksetup, scutil, ifconfig, netstat, route, ipconfig, sysctl, sw_vers, ping, dig, curl, dscacheutil, killall, arp and sudo on the Mac the tool runs on.

components.name: Network endpoints
components.responsibility: What the probes reach: the public-internet probes, the internal hosts given with --internal-host, DNS servers asked directly, and the system proxies and PAC file.
